correctness.rationale: The actual finite universe has 20 three-subset centers and 20 queries; closed radius-one predicate is |C intersection Q|>=2, including equality. Independently recomputed all 4845 unordered four-query supports against all 20 centers, obtaining exactly trace counts 4:45, 8:1680, 14:3120. A 3-query support has 8 traces; full exact version-space recurrence independently gives Littlestone depth 4. Each of the 16 leaves in provided tree.json specifies a center and the source verify.py checks each path; 2^5>20 excludes depth 5. The smaller J(4,2),J(5,2),J(6,2) cases are established by finite exhaustive recurrence and counting, with complete-graph cases depth zero. No extrapolation to all Johnson sizes is asserted.
